hooks.name: spec-drift-check
hooks.description: After each spec task completes, ask the agent to confirm the implementation still satisfies the requirement numbers it cites.

action.prompt: A spec task just finished. Re-read the requirements it referenced and confirm that every requirement number cited in tasks.md is fully satisfied by the current implementation. If any requirement is not met or the implementation has drifted from the design, describe the gap and fix it before continuing.
